 1               P R O C E E D I N G S

 2                THE PRESIDENT:   The Senate will 

 3   now come to order.  

 4                I would like to ask everybody 

 5   present to please rise and repeat with me the 

 6   Pledge of Allegiance, face the Flag. 

 7                (Whereupon, the assemblage recited 

 8   the Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag.)

 9                THE PRESIDENT:   May we now bow our 

10   heads in a moment of silence, please. 

11                (Whereupon, the assemblage 

12   respected a moment of silence.)

13                THE PRESIDENT:   May we now have 

14   the reading of the Journal.

15                THE SECRETARY:   In Senate, Monday, 

16   January 6, the Senate met pursuant to 

17   adjournment.  The Journal of Friday, January 3, 

18   was read and approved.  On motion, Senate 

19   adjourned.

20                THE PRESIDENT:   Without objection, 

21   the Journal stands approved as read.

22                Next, presentation of petitions.

23                Any messages from the Assembly.  

24                Messages from the Governor.  

25                Reports of standing committees.


                                                                4936

 1                Reports of select committees.

 2                Communications and reports from 

 3   state officers.

 4                Motions and resolutions.

 5                Floor Leader.

 6                SENATOR LIBOUS:   Mr. President, 

 7   thank you.  

 8                I believe there's a resolution at 

 9   the desk.  At this time I'd ask that it be read 

10   in its entirety and we move for its immediate 

11   adoption, please.

12                THE PRESIDENT:   The Secretary will 

13   read.

14                THE SECRETARY:   Concurrent 

15   Resolution of the Senate and Assembly relative 

16   to the adjournment sine die of the 2013 session 

17   of the Legislature.  

18                "RESOLVED, That the 2013 session of 

19   the Legislature adjourn sine die on Wednesday, 

20   January 8, 2014, simultaneously with the 

21   commencement of the 2014 Legislative Session."

22                THE PRESIDENT:   The question is on 

23   the resolution.  All those in favor signify by 

24   saying aye.

25                (Response of "Aye.")


                                                                4937

 1                THE PRESIDENT:   Opposed?  

 2                (No response.)

 3                THE PRESIDENT:   The resolution is 

 4   adopted.  

 5                The 236th Legislative Session is 

 6   now adjourned sine die.

 7                (Whereupon, at 12:26 p.m., the 

 8   Senate adjourned.)
